intro.title: What is Cloud Native Days Italy
intro.lead: Cloud Native Days Italy is a community-driven event dedicated to cloud native and open source technologies.
intro.description: It brings together developers, architects, engineers, DevOps and IT professionals — the whole Italian cloud native and Kubernetes community, and anyone excited about what cloud native makes possible. Our goal is simple: grow the Italian cloud native community by giving it a place to meet, share and learn, together.

steps.title: Born as KCD Italy
steps.text: The first Kubernetes Community Days Italy: a fully virtual edition, organized by the community for the community.

steps.title: The community grows
steps.text: A second virtual edition, with more talks, more speakers and a growing community around the event.

steps.title: Finally in person
steps.text: For the first time the community meets in person: faces, hallway chats and live demos replace the video calls.

steps.title: The last KCD
steps.text: The fourth edition closes the Kubernetes Community Days chapter of our story.

steps.title: Cloud Native Days Italy
steps.text: A new, independent identity with a wider scope: all things cloud native, beyond Kubernetes.

steps.title: The biggest edition so far
steps.text: Two days in Bologna with hundreds of attendees, workshops, a sponsor area and a community & open source area.

steps.title: Next stop: Bologna
steps.text: The story continues on 20 May 2027. Be part of it.
